age.evidence: The experiments were performed on adult male Wistar rats (SPF Velaz, s.r.o., Czechia) weighing 280-300 g at the time of surgery.

dosing.evidence: Psilocin (PSI, THC-Pharm GmbH, Germany) was dissolved in 2 ml of saline (0.9% NaCl) acidified by 10 m l of glacial acetic acid... administrated in a dose of 4 mg/kg subcutaneously (SC).

handling.evidence: The animals were housed in pairs and were regularly handled every second day.

group_housing.evidence: The animals were housed in pairs... The rats were then housed individually in cages in order to prevent damage to implanted electrodes (housing during testing period was individual).

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12-h light/dark regime... The experiments were conducted during the daytime between 8:00 and 14:00.

judge_notes: Primary endpoint of the paper is qEEG (power, coherence, GFC), which is a neural recording and per the rubric is NOT scored as a behavioural assay.

The only behavioural readout reported is the active/inactive ratio scored concurrently in the home cage during EEG recording (Section 2.6, Figures 2A/3A). This is included as one home-cage behavioural activity assay, matching the qwen candidate's interpretation; the glm candidate produced no assays.
Group housing scored 'no' because during behavioural testing rats were housed individually (paired pre-surgery only) — rubric specifies housing during testing period.
application_type set to 'multiple' since psilocin (s.c.) was co-administered with antagonists (s.c.) or clozapine (i.p.) depending on the arm.
